response: The internet originated in the 1960s with ARPANET, first demonstrated in 1969, and adopted the foundational TCP/IP protocols in 1983. Tim Berners-Lee created the World Wide Web in 1989, and the 1993 Mosaic browser brought it to the public, fueling the dot-com boom and subsequent 2001 crash that left survivors like Amazon and Google. The mid-2000s rise of social media and the 2007 iPhone launch made the internet mobile and ubiquitous, while cloud computing emerged as a major force. Today, it connects over 5 billion people and underpins nearly every facet of modern life.
